items.message:
There is no longer a threat of flooding, though standing water and debris may still remain. 
Coastal conditions are expected to improve and no flooding is expected. Tides remain high. 
We will continue to monitor the situation and will issue further alerts or warnings if necessary.   
If you have been evacuated only return to your property once the emergency services have advised that it is safe to do so. Never drive through flood water,  just 30cm of fast flowing water is enough to move your car.

High river levels today may lead to flooding. 
Flooding is possible on 31 August 2026  
Heavy rainfall has caused river levels at Whitewater Bridge Gauge to rise overnight. River levels will remain high throughout today (31/08/2026). Light rainfall is forecast over the next 12 hours.

Areas most at risk are low-lying agricultural land and roads around Mansfield, the Sherwood Forest Caravan Park at Clipstone, Edwinstowe, Ollerton, Whitewater Lane at Whitewater Bridge and West Drayton. 
We are closely monitoring the situation & monitoring river levels and rainfall. 
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses & monitor local water levels and weather conditions. 
This message will be updated by 5:00PM on 31 August 2026 or as the situation changes.
